clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Agentic Services; applies when using agentic services, including Computer Use API.
clauses.condition_explanation: agentic_service_use_with_responsibility_authorization_and_supervision means the licensee takes sole responsibility for service actions and tasks, determines suitability, authorizes access and connections to data, applications, and systems, and exercises judgment and supervision when used in production.

obligation_items.content: Take sole responsibility for actions and tasks performed by the agentic service, determine whether it is appropriate for the use case, authorize its access and connections to data, applications, and systems, and exercise judgment and supervision when it is used in production.
obligation_items.object: Agentic service and its actions, tasks, access, and connections
obligation_items.trigger: When using agentic services; production judgment and supervision apply when and if the service is used in production.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Agentic Services; prohibits automatically bypassing any requests for human confirmation when using agentic services.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to automatic bypass of a human-confirmation request.

obligation_items.content: Do not automatically bypass any request for human confirmation.
obligation_items.object: Human-confirmation requests encountered by an agentic service
obligation_items.trigger: When using agentic services and a request for human confirmation is made.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search; use is restricted to the licensee's own operated application, and display is limited to the end user who submitted the prompt.
clauses.condition_explanation: The application must be both owned and operated by the licensee; Grounded Results must be displayed with associated Search Suggestions to the prompt-submitting end user.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Grounding with Google Search in an application not owned and operated by you, and do not display Grounded Results without associated Search Suggestions or to anyone other than the end user who submitted the prompt.
obligation_items.object: Grounding with Google Search and its Grounded Results and associated Search Suggestions
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using Grounding with Google Search or displaying its results.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search; applies to Grounded Results, Search Suggestions, and their components, including Links, and also prohibits allowing end users or third parties to engage in the restricted uses.
clauses.condition_explanation: Prohibited uses include caching, framing, syndicating, reselling, analyzing, training on, or otherwise learning from Grounded Results or Search Suggestions, and extracting or collecting one or more components for another purpose, including automated Link collection, indexing, crawling, or scraping.

obligation_items.content: Do not, and do not allow an end user or third party to, cache, frame, syndicate, resell, analyze, train on, or otherwise learn from Grounded Results or Search Suggestions, or extract or collect those components for another purpose.
obligation_items.object: Grounded Results, Search Suggestions, and Links in Grounded Results
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever dealing with Grounding with Google Search results or components.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search; baseline restriction on copying, storing, and implementing click, Link, or other monitoring, subject to the exceptions in lines 249–276.
clauses.condition_explanation: Copying or storing Grounded Results or Search Suggestions, and implementing click tracking, Link-tracking, or other monitoring of them, is prohibited unless a stated exception applies.

obligation_items.content: Do not copy or store Grounded Results or Search Suggestions or implement click tracking, Link-tracking, or other monitoring of them except as expressly permitted by the listed exceptions.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever copying, storing, or monitoring these materials; subject to the specific exceptions in lines 249–276.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search; exceptions to the copy/store/monitor restriction for the developer. The two-year limit applies to the first two listed purposes; the third has its own temporary-storage and handling conditions.
clauses.condition_explanation: The developer may copy and store result text displayed by the developer only for evaluation/optimization or the prompt submitter's chat history, each for up to two years. Alternatively, temporary storage is allowed to resubmit text to Google via a function call for a refined or improved result, only if all stated interim-result deletion, purpose limitation, and final-display conditions are met.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search; exception to the copy/store restriction for the Grounded Result and Search Suggestions.
clauses.condition_explanation: Both the exclusive legal-compliance purpose and minimum necessary storage period are required.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search; permits allowing an end user to copy and store an individual Grounded Result displayed to that user, subject to the stated restrictions.
clauses.condition_explanation: The result must be an individual Grounded Result displayed to the end user through the application; the licensee must not allow automated or programmatic access or collection, or use to create a database.

obligation_items.content: Do not allow Grounded Results copied or stored by end users to be accessed or collected by automated or programmatic means or used to create a database.
obligation_items.object: Grounded Results displayed to end users
obligation_items.trigger: When allowing end users to copy and store individual displayed Grounded Results.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search; permits monitoring user interactions with the application interface but not tracking whether interaction was with a particular result, suggestion, or Link, in whole or part.
clauses.condition_explanation: General interface interaction monitoring is allowed; tracking interaction with a specific Grounded Result, Search Suggestion, or Link is prohibited.

obligation_items.content: Do not track whether end-user interactions were specifically with a given Grounded Result, Search Suggestion, or Link, in whole or part.
obligation_items.object: End-user interactions with Grounded Results, Search Suggestions, or Links
obligation_items.trigger: When monitoring end-user interactions with the application interface.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search; prohibits modifying or interspersing content with results/suggestions and specified interference with destinations, unless Google permits in writing.
clauses.condition_explanation: Without Google's written permission, do not modify or intersperse other content with Grounded Results or Search Suggestions; do not place interstitial content between a Link or Search Suggestion and its destination, redirect users away, or inhibit full and complete display of a destination page.

obligation_items.content: Do not modify or intersperse other content with Grounded Results or Search Suggestions; place interstitial content between a Link or Search Suggestion and its destination; redirect end users away from destination pages; or minimize, remove, or otherwise inhibit their full and complete display.
obligation_items.object: Grounded Results, Search Suggestions, Links, and associated destination pages
obligation_items.trigger: Unless Google has permitted the action in writing.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search data-use term; Google stores prompts, provided contextual information, and output for 30 days for creating Grounded Results and Search Suggestions and may use the stored information for debugging and testing supporting systems. Paid-quota Gemini API debugging/testing processing is under the referenced Data Processing Addendum.
clauses.condition_explanation: Applies when using Grounding with Google Search. The 30-day period and stated creation purpose apply to Google's storage; debugging/testing use is stated for stored information. For paid-quota Gemini API, the referenced addendum governs that processing.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search subsection survives termination of the Agreement, as applicable; this is a survival rule, not a new use grant.
clauses.condition_explanation: The subsection continues to apply after termination to the extent applicable.

coverage_notes: Lines 165–184 incorporate external Google Cloud Terms sections and pricing/billing terms; their substantive payment, dispute, regional, and credit provisions are not supplied. Lines 186–192 state that Paid Services fees are specified on the pricing page, pricing can change on the stated notice schedule (new Paid Services may take effect immediately), and continued use constitutes consent. The actual prices and payment duties cannot be extracted from the supplied text; payment is not represented as Charge/SellCopies.
Lines 194–196 exclude direct use of GCP services from these Terms; this scope boundary is context, not a separate activity rule.

Grounding with Google Search definitions and destination-page cross-references in lines 210–226 are context; the no-assertion-of-ownership statement in lines 224–226 is not converted into an attribution duty.
Lines 303–307 apply external Client Application Guidelines, whose requirements are not supplied.

The referenced general data-use terms, Data Processing Addendum, API Terms, Cloud Terms, pricing page, and applicable Documentation are not supplied; no unstated obligations or permissions are inferred.
